articles.title: Carney's 'hydronym' moment is behind a cheeky campaign to raise awareness about Lake Ontario
articles.summary: Riding on Prime Minister Mark Carney's use of the proper word for a body of water, a London, Ont., company has created T-shirts emblazoned with "My hydronyms are Lake and Ontario." A portion of the apparel sales proceeds go to Swim Drink Fish Canada, a charity that connects people with the lake, and works to keep it safe and clean.

articles.title: Police investigating after man stabbed in North York
articles.summary: A man has been taken to hospital after being stabbed in North York Tuesday night. Police were called to Wilson Avenue and Keele Street just before 7:30 p.m. The victime was taken to hospital with serious, non-life-threatening injuries, according to EMS. No suspect description has been made available at this point.

articles.title: Bombardier to buy Mitsubishi aerospace plant near Pearson airport
articles.summary: MONTREAL — Bombardier Inc. says it will buy Mitsubishi's main Canadian aerospace factory, bringing in-house an operation that was previously outsourced.

articles.title: Inquest set for 88-year-old who died after well-being check by Peel police in 2023
articles.summary: An inquest will be held next week into the death of an 88-year-old man who died after he fell down a flight of stairs during a well-being check by Peel police in Mississauga nearly three years ago.

articles.title: Ontario's new cash bail system on hold after judge grants injunction
articles.summary: Ontario's new cash bail system has been put on hold while a judge weighs a challenge to its constitutionality.

articles.title: Liberals win federal byelection in Beaches-East York
articles.summary: Liberal Tanveer Shahnawaz has won the federal byelection in the Toronto riding of Beaches-East York, maintaining the party's stronghold in the riding.
